Apple to Release iOS 27 with AI Features

Apple is set to release its new operating system, iOS 27, which will include updated features such as a new Siri avatar, AI capabilities, and visual intelligence. The update will also bring changes to the user interface and parental controls. The new operating system is expected to be rolled out to compatible iPhone models soon. The coverage also mentions potential future iPhone models like the 'iPhone 18 Pro'.
